title: Site-scoped CPU observations
responsibility: Filters agent CPU observations to processes attributed to the hosted repository.

inputs.name: siteProcesses.snapshot
inputs.description: CPU sample with machine totals, groups and optional agent entries.

inputs.name: siteProcesses.directoryOf
inputs.description: Optional PID-to-working-directory lookup. Defaults to reading the process directory, falling back to lsof; unknown directories exclude the agent.

outputs.name: siteProcesses
outputs.description: Snapshot preserving machine data and non-agent groups, with only site-owned agents, recalculated agent totals and recalculated tracked percentage unless it was null. Samples lacking agents or groups are returned unchanged.
